messages:
jules: i'm opening a small PR to add a 'cost forecast' widget to the pricing analytics page and to ship a concise python SDK snippet showing the new header we discussed for request-level plan attribution. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6218

marta: useful. what's the forecast widget doing exactly? we should avoid promising future accuracy.

jules: it's conservative: shows 24h forecast using P95 rate * current unit_cost, with a short note that forecasts use sampled traffic and a multiplier. the grafana panel will query `billing.cost_forecast_p95` and surface a 24h extrapolation.

owen: sounds fine. please include the raw query and the exact panel UID in the migration note so customers can update copies. also add a single-sentence caveat about bursty noise.

jules: added query snippet in the doc and UID G-forecast21 in the migration note. caveat: "Forecasts smooth short spikes; for burst-prone apps expect variance."

sai: about the header: agreed we should standardize on `X-Plan-Tier` for plan attribution in examples. can you show the python snippet here so i can sanity-check header casing and auth?

jules: here's the python snippet included in the PR:
```
# python (requests)
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  headers={
    'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['RW_KEY']}",
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'X-Plan-Tier': 'enterprise'
  },
  json={"model": "open-7b", "input": "Summarize recent costs"}
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```

sai: LGTM. tiny nit: call out that header is case-insensitive and accepted in either hyphen or underscore form for legacy clients.

jules: added note: "API accepts X-Plan-Tier and x_plan_tier for legacy integrations; prefer X-Plan-Tier going forward."

marta: for the forecast math please add a short example: "if P95 rate=10 req/s and unit_cost=0.0002 USD/token with avg tokens 120 -> forecast ~ 10*120*0.0002*86400 = ~2073 USD/day" so customers can eyeball estimates.

jules: added that example and a short link to the cost model page.

docs-ci-bot: running lint, snippet-tests and linkcheck on PR #6218.

owen: also please include a small FAQ blurb explaining why forecast might differ from billing exports (export includes hourly reconciliations and credits).

jules: did that. included reconciliation note and cross-ref to billing exports guide.

docs-ci-bot: snippet-tests failed: recorded fixture expects header `X-Usage-Tier`. update fixtures or re-record.

jules: updated snippet fixtures to assert X-Plan-Tier and re-recorded the failing test. repushed.

docs-ci-bot: all checks passing at 4978881260. merge scheduled after docs site rebuild.

sai: thanks, will add a short item to the migration checklist to notify partners about the new widget and header rename.

jules: thanks everyone  closing thread.
